amendment_1.reason_verbatim: band 144e9 collided with d2r2-freeze's branch-resident claim; registry check scoped to the main tree missed unmerged-branch claims.
amendment_1.finding: a pre-launch review found the original band, 144000000000, ALSO claimed the same day on an unmerged sibling branch (d2r2-freeze's measurement/track_d2r2_prep/, own BAND_REGISTRY.csv row present on that branch) -- invisible to a main-tree-scoped registry check, which this build ran TWICE (design time + immediately before the CSV append) and still missed, because both checks read only the checked-out branch's own governance/BAND_REGISTRY.csv. A second unmerged branch, d1-rebase-freeze, separately claimed 145000000000 (measurement/track_d1_fair_rebase/) the same day, and additionally SOFT-RESERVED (documented, not formally claimed -- status DRAFT-NOT-CLAIMED, no registry row) 146000000000 for its own future n-extension.
amendment_1.corrected_procedure: for every local branch (git for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short)' refs/heads/), git ls-tree -r --name-only <branch> -- measurement/ | grep -i 'BAND_CLAIM\.json$', then git show <branch>:<path> to read the claimed range for every hit; take the lowest free integer clear of the highest thing found anywhere across ALL branches, not just the local registry's own high-water mark. This gap is a finding for the next claimer's procedure to include, not just a one-off fix.
amendment_1.why_147_not_146: 146000000000 is not FORMALLY claimed anywhere (no registry row on any branch), but d1-rebase-freeze has explicitly earmarked it in its own committed design for a future n=800-decks/rung extension of that track's six-cell design and asked that nothing run there without its own fresh funding decision; taking it here would reproduce the same class of collision this amendment exists to fix the moment that extension is funded, so this design treats it as unavailable and picks the next band confirmed clear across every branch instead.
